terra.problem: It says the crowd shows up to the Tent, but the text says the congregation assembled at Shiloh and then set it up.
Joshua asks how long the Israelites will put off entering and possessing the land, not why they are doing so.
The text does not say nobody is rushing, and Joshua asks how long the Israelites will put off entering and possessing the land, not why.
The seven tribes waiting do not establish which tribes supply the mapmakers. The text also does not say they travel together or that nobody gets lost alone.
The text does not say the men take no swords on their surveying trip.
The explanation is generic and repeats that the assignment does not involve altars without adding much personality or insight.
The text does not say there is no arguing over the portions.
Caleb's tribe and his receipt of land are facts from outside this passage and need references.
The joke uses leftovers as a food comparison, but cookies are the only food permitted in comparisons here.
The text says Joshua rebuilt the city and settled in it, but does not say he finished rebuilding it before settling there.
The text does not establish that Joshua rebuilt the city before moving into it.
